notes.title: FICTION #F3F is now fiction.colors! 2 New Games :)
notes.content:
Hey all!
Longtime :)

So first of all, if you hadn't noticed by the library and store name + art change, or header and subtitle of this post already: 

FICTION #F3F
has been
renamed
to

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/0e18abc5dd3e21cf0380fa83d457b51ed7631a62.png

Woo! 

Why you ask? 
yea why?

Well tldr: what was going to be a series is now a growing collection

Yes planned a short game collection series, named after hex codes, FICTION #F3F the first of many... But classic overscope moment there. Im tired haha, want an easy digital medium to share any cool weird small stuff, experiments or short games im working on. Let it grow over time.


that brought a new launcher! so if you still see the pink fiction f3f launcher pls uninstall and reinstall the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/c87a14bf2927aa8d156e57e4f3a6c1a9e442b080.gif
this is the new launcher, again if you dont see this or you get an error pls reinstall game.

also

Two new Games!!


*24 Jingles to Bell
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/a1d87e4517b3b5a83e5c3d326a1adb8bc8b37eb9.gif
Explore a largeish open world as one of Santa's Reindeer in this goofy non horror short game about drunk driving made for the Haunted PS1 2021 Madvent calendar. With an amazing soundtrack composed by Jasmine Cooper, its good reminds me of Morrowind. 

*Story of a Line
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187218/d7016180778bdbab2b20257c344324945689052e.gif
A peaceful passive visual narrative about the story of a line making its way through a large world of lines. This was my second game, still holds up haha, made it after releasing dreamsim and while working on what would become 0n0w. It is randomly/procedurally generated so the lines journey is different every time.


Well, hope you all enjoy the new experiences, will be adding more in the future,
hope you're all well!

Best,
-Colorfiction
 <3
